>I can't imagine that this is legal, but I've got to ask. And what

You receive a warning from the judge for misplaying / misrepresenting
the state of the game, then it goes back into your hand, the card you
drew goes back into your deck, and you are assessed a penalty for
gaining knowledge of the rest of your deck illegally.

Section 5.1 of the tournament rules.
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/veknRules.html

5.1 Cheating
Misrepresenting rules or card texts or errata
Drawing extra cards
Misrepresenting public information (pool totals, number of cards in
deck, and so on)

Messages.Author: Nystulc
Messages.Body:
Emile wrote:

>Card text does not say that you must anounce the number of shock
>troops you create
>
>Shock Troops [SW]
>Cardtype: Master
>
>Cost: X pool

Well, yes it does. You must pay the cost when you play the card. Therefore,
you must decide what X is when you play the card.

><Master.> Requires a ready archbishop or cardinal.
>Put X Master: Discipline cards from your hand into play.

And then the next thing you do, after playing the card, is resolve the effect.
Some effects, like actions or strikes, take time to resolve. But almost all
master cards are resolved instantly, before anything else happens, and before
any replacing is done. Once you replace your master card, the effect is
finished.
